question: What decision currently governs python multiphase extension init policy after the implementation PR was reverted? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: PEP-489 is the currently active decision governing multi-phase extension module initialization policy in Python, evidenced by PEP 489 (https://github.com/python/peps/blob/b2120d116aa696f409b4d8333c4020ab8f93c9c7/peps/pep-0489.rst).
python/cpython#19128 is the currently active decision regarding the _weakref implementation, which reverted the multiphase initialization port introduced in python/cpython#19084.
python/cpython#19084 historically ported the _weakref extension to multi-phase initialization under PEP 489 before being reverted.
